messages:
anika: FYI vuln-scan just flagged a libcrypto CVE in our staging base image (rbase:2025-03-18). marking medium-high. we should coordinate a rebuild + signing ASAP. who can own?

ben: ack. which registry tag exactly — staging or prod?

anika: staging first: registry.redwood-internal/base/rbase:2025-03-18. prod still on rbase:2024-12-01.

carla: I can take the rebuild. quick question — do we need to rotate the KMS signer before re-signing? staging uses ephemeral-keystore but prod uses keystore-prod. @dustin do we have RBAC gaps?

dustin: we should avoid rotating prod signer unless necessary. for staging, using ephemeral signer is fine. RBAC: cosign:signer role is held by carla + sec-automation service account and platform-svc. I'll audit the bindings.

elaine: audit note — I saw some denied sign attempts yesterday around 15:12 from a deploy job. might be related to a maintenance window. will pull logs.

ben: I saw an IAM deny spike at 15:12 too. could be the same window. OK, plan: rebuild minimal base, run unit tests + vuln-scan, sign with ephemeral staging signer and push a canary tag rbase:2025-03-18-canary.

carla: plan sounds good. who signs off on the canary? need sec-eng + platform review.

anika: requesting review from @dustin and @elaine.

dustin: I'll validate RBAC + audit trail once canary is up. also we must forward the sign event to SIEM — add that to runbook.

elaine: add a manual check to confirm the KMS envelope key matches rotation schedule — we had a drift last month. add to the checklist.

carla: rollout steps: 1) build minimal base with openssl upgrade 3.0.8, 2) run unit + vuln scans, 3) cosign sign with ephemeral staging key, 4) push canary to 5% staging infra, 5) smoke tests (latency, kv-cache). rollback is to retag previous base rbase:2024-12-01 and run /scripts/revert-base.sh in infra repo.

ben: I can trigger the canary pipeline after you push. will post link here.

anika: I'll file an incident ticket and include compliance owner and retention notes; if this goes to prod we capture in postmortem.

dustin: before prod sign, confirm cosign key perms: signer principal needs kms:Decrypt + cloudkms.signBlob. I'll validate IAM policy pre-prod.

deploy-bot: Pipeline #4872 started for registry.redwood-internal/base/rbase:2025-03-18 (triggered by ben).

carla: build finished. vuln-scan output: ```Scanning base layers... found CVE-2025-0007 in libcrypto (fixed in openssl 3.0.8)```

anika: OK update base to openssl 3.0.8 and rebuild.

carla: rebuilt and signed canary: rbase:2025-03-18-canary (signed with ephemeral staging key). pushed to staging canary group.

dustin: audit log shows sign event from sec-automation@staging using KMS key projects/rdw/locations/global/keyRings/signer/cryptoKeys/ephemeral-2025. no denies observed. forwarding event to SIEM. LGTM.

elaine: requesting smoke tests now. include check of audit-forwarding and retention metadata.

ben: smoke results: latency stable, kv-cache warm-up OK, no errors in logs.

anika: we'll monitor canary for 24h and security review. if green, schedule prod sign 2025-03-19 02:00 UTC.

dustin: I'll revalidate IAM policies at 01:30 UTC before prod sign and confirm access to keystore-prod. if something fails we execute rollback script.

carla: updating runbook with the KMS envelope check and delaying signer rotation until after deploy.

ben: CI link: https://ci.redwood/rebuild/4872 (results attached).

anika: assigning owners: carla (build), ben (canary trigger), dustin+elaine (RBAC/audit review). Filing ticket and adding compliance owner. Closing thread after prod sign. :lock:
